summary: Final end-to-end regression and security sweep of the P0 reliability fix pack (F1–F5). Every suite in the battery passed; every failure that appeared along the way was reproduced in the correct isolated environment and classified as environment or test-setup noise, not a product regression. No code was changed and no commit was needed — the sweep proved the five fixes safe rather than adding anything.
what_was_done: Ran the full battery: the five P0 fix suites, the lifecycle/reliability suites, the auth and API contract suites, the BrowserStack truthfulness and execution-provenance suites, and the security negative tests

Re-ran every failing suite in its correct isolated environment (its own data folder and required-auth server) before classifying it — for example phase17/phase18 and the API contract suite fail on the shared dev server only because it runs in open mode
Confirmed the git tree was clean before and after the sweep: no unrelated changes, all five fix commits (F1–F5) intact, HEAD 4ce0803
Recorded the full pass/fail/skip matrix with commands and totals in the ticket description
what_was_tested: All five fixes hold at HEAD: BrowserStack config validation, browser ownership during awaiting_input, interrupted-state reasons, cross-user isolation, and browser frame recovery after resume
Earlier R1/R2 lifecycle guarantees still hold (awaiting_input expiry, mission stop, timeouts, cancellation, cleanup, boot orphan sweep, runtime kick protection)

Cross-user isolation verified end-to-end against a required-auth server with two real operator accounts: listing, detail, mutation, stop, answer, live stream, and evidence access are all denied cross-owner
Auth semantics: open mode for local dev unchanged, required mode enforced, integration-auth workspace scoping intact

review_checklist: Spot-check one behavior you care about: pause a run at a question, start another mission, resume the first — the browser panel should reconnect and stream again (F5) and both runs keep their own browsers (F2)
Open a session that was interrupted by a server restart — it should say why (e.g. 'interrupted — server restart') and keep its pending question (F3)
With two user accounts, confirm one user cannot see or open the other's runs, bugs, or live streams (F4)
In Settings, enter invalid BrowserStack credentials and run a scheduled test — it should fail loudly as a provider error, never silently run locally (F1)
